_meta.description: The single authoritative code index of this project: every function, class, method, route, test, Vue component, CSS section and doc section with a label, plus each file's purpose. Query it with the shared code-index tool (find / show / callers); do not read this file whole. Generated: never edit by hand; hand-written notes live in code_index/project.json.

.github/workflows/style-audit.yml.purpose: GitHub Actions workflow that runs the panel theme style audit when public assets or style-audit scripts change.
.github/workflows/style-audit.yml.read_when: When changing panel CSS/JS under nce_events/public, scripts/style-audit, or CI path triggers for the theme contract job.

.pre-commit-config.yaml.purpose: Pre-commit configuration for ruff, prettier, eslint, pyright, standard hooks, and build-code-index sync on commit.
.pre-commit-config.yaml.read_when: When adding or adjusting local lint/format hooks, exclude patterns, or the build-code-index check scope.
gotchas: Prettier and eslint exclude dist, node_modules, jinja includes, and nce_events panel/evaluations dist bundles.
Pyright runs in basic mode on nce_events/api; tests excluded via pyrightconfig until Phase 11.
build-code-index --check runs only when nce_events sources, CODE_INDEX.manual.json, or the build script change.

AGENTS.md.purpose: Agent guide for NCE Events: where to add code, reusable helpers, and project conventions.
AGENTS.md.read_when: Before adding features or searching for existing helpers in api/, panel_page, or panel_page_v2.
gotchas: Read Docs/project_reference.md first; do not change code without it.
No bench commands; push to GitHub for deployment.

CLAUDE.md.purpose: AI agent codebase reference for NCE Events architecture, DocTypes, API, and Form Dialog capture flow.
CLAUDE.md.read_when: When onboarding to NCE Events or tracing Form Dialog capture, panel V2, and API modules.
gotchas: Never run bench commands or git reset --hard; deployment is separate.
Script capture temporarily replaces frappe.ui.form.on; always restored in finally.

README.md.purpose: Project README for the NCE Events Frappe app: Panel Explorer, Tag Finder, install steps, and contributing.
README.md.read_when: When you need a high-level overview, install steps, or links to Docs/project_reference.md.

nce_events/__init__.py.purpose: NCE Events Frappe app package root defining the installed __version__ string for releases and compatibility.
nce_events/__init__.py.read_when: When bumping or reading the nce_events __version__ for releases or compatibility checks.

nce_events/api/__init__.py.purpose: Top-level NCE Events whitelisted API methods including GET CSV download for a Page Panel dataset.
nce_events/api/__init__.py.read_when: When wiring GET /api/method/nce_events.api.get_panel or adding new package-level whitelisted entry points.

nce_events/api/credentials.py.purpose: Load API Connector credential_config JSON or auth_type fallback into auth_pattern, base_url, and secret fields.
nce_events/api/credentials.py.read_when: When exchange, messaging, LLM, or WooCommerce clients need connector secrets without duplicating read logic.
gotchas: Always include username in the result when set; often used for sender identity outside auth_type fields.

nce_events/api/derived_fields.py.purpose: Compose WP Tables derived SQL specs with sql_eval to evaluate and merge derived values into document dicts.
nce_events/api/derived_fields.py.read_when: When applying column_mapping derived columns to a row or doc without calling wp_tables_mapping and sql_eval separately.

nce_events/api/evaluations.py.purpose: Whitelisted API listing event enrollments with player details and normalized ratings for rating Kanban views.
nce_events/api/evaluations.py.read_when: When changing event enrollment queries, rating lanes 0-7, or Enrollments versus Registrations schema detection.

nce_events/api/event_people_map.py.purpose: Whitelisted API that returns Google Maps pins for people enrolled on an event, geocoded from family addresses.
nce_events/api/event_people_map.py.read_when: When loading the event people map UI or debugging geocoding, Family GPS writes, or skipped pin counts.
gotchas: Pins use Family GPS latitude/longitude first; Google is called only when both coordinates are missing or zero.
A successful Google lookup is saved onto Family GPS without overwriting a usable coordinate pair.
Geocode failures skip individual pins, write error_message on Family GPS, and the request still succeeds.
People without a usable family address are counted in skipped_no_address.

nce_events/api/events_publish.py.purpose: Sync Frappe Events rows to WooCommerce products and handle duplicate, new product, and delete flows.
nce_events/api/events_publish.py.read_when: When publishing Events to WooCommerce, duplicating or deleting events, or reading update confirmation payloads.
gotchas: update_events_to_website always PUTs from a fresh DB read after save; generated sku needs committed row.
There is no change-detection on publish; every update_events_to_website call pushes WooCommerce.
New and duplicate products default wc_product_type to simple until WooCommerce assigns taxonomy.
clear_new_woo_commerce_product uses set_single_value only to avoid mandatory validation on blanking the form.

nce_events/api/exchange.py.purpose: Posts WordPress nce-exchange and refund endpoints for enrollments, bulk refunds, and shared HTTP error handling.
nce_events/api/exchange.py.read_when: When wiring Form Dialog exchange/refund actions, bulk delete refunds, or debugging WordPress REST failures.
gotchas: Successful enrollment exchange or refund defers local Enrollments cleanup to the next WP→Frappe sync.
Exchange calls use WordPress Application Password Basic Auth with form-urlencoded bodies, not JSON.
Bulk refund 404 responses expect nce-product-exchange v1.3.0+ at refund-items-by-product.

nce_events/api/form_dialog/__init__.py.purpose: Re-exports Form Dialog whitelisted APIs split from form_dialog_api: capture, related rows, portal, save, and helpers.
nce_events/api/form_dialog/__init__.py.read_when: When importing the Form Dialog server API surface or finding which submodule owns a whitelisted method.
gotchas: Capture, rebuild, and list require System Manager.
get_form_dialog_definition and get_form_dialog_related_rows are readable by any logged-in user for active V2 panel dialogs.
save_form_dialog_document uses normal DocType create or write permission on the target record.

nce_events/api/form_dialog/_fd_capture_m.purpose: Frozen meta capture for Form Dialog: tab skeleton, client scripts, table grid flags, and tab-note sync.
nce_events/api/form_dialog/_fd_capture_m.read_when: When extending Desk capture of form layout sections, scripts, or tab visibility for Form Dialog.
gotchas: Section column count sync affects frozen layout skeleton; review _sync_section_column_count changes.

nce_events/api/form_dialog/_fd_fetch_fro.purpose: Enrich fetch_from fields in frozen Form Dialog schemas so captured field JSON matches linked DocType display widgets.
nce_events/api/form_dialog/_fd_fetch_fro.read_when: When Link fetch_from metadata is missing or wrong in captured Form Dialog field JSON.

nce_events/api/form_dialog/_fd_gating.py.purpose: Form Dialog gating helpers: WP Tables validation, System Manager checks, and capture schema readiness.
nce_events/api/form_dialog/_fd_gating.py.read_when: When blocking capture or portal use for DocTypes not in WP Tables or missing required panel values.

nce_events/api/form_dialog/_fd_inline_ch.purpose: Build and sync Form Dialog Inline Child Table rows with frozen child field JSON during capture and rebuild.
nce_events/api/form_dialog/_fd_inline_ch.read_when: When capture or rebuild parses inline_child_tables or lists Table fields for the capture wizard.
gotchas: Nested Table child DocTypes used only as schema helpers may be absent from WP Tables; capture entry already gates root target_doctype.

nce_events/api/form_dialog/_fd_related.p.purpose: Form Dialog related tab helpers for hop chains, QBTL rows, sync, list filters, and portal merge keys.
nce_events/api/form_dialog/_fd_related.p.read_when: When debugging related-tab hop chains, QBTL bind plans, capture sync, or related row list filters.
gotchas: Hop chain normalization affects related row signatures; changing _normalize_hop_chain_value impacts dedup.
portal_fields is imported at call time in _related_list_columns_from_child_row to avoid circular load with _helpers.
Same-table related tab filters use the opened row's link_field value (sibling group), not root_name as row id.
When _hop_walk_final_identifiers returns None, _filters_for_related_rows sets force_empty so callers return zero rows.

nce_events/api/form_dialog/_fd_script_to.purpose: Parse and sync script tool group rows on Form Dialog during schema capture from the Desk wizard.
nce_events/api/form_dialog/_fd_script_to.read_when: When Form Dialog capture must persist or preserve script tool groups from wizard input.

nce_events/api/form_dialog/_helpers.py.purpose: Back-compat facade re-exporting form_dialog _fd_* submodule helpers for older import paths.
nce_events/api/form_dialog/_helpers.py.read_when: When tracing legacy imports of form_dialog helpers that now live in _fd_* modules.
gotchas: New code should import from _fd_* modules directly; this module exists to avoid churn at old call sites.

nce_events/api/form_dialog/action_regist.purpose: Allow-listed server method specs for Form Dialog portal row buttons resolved at runtime via dotted_path.
nce_events/api/form_dialog/action_regist.read_when: When validating portal action keys, building UI prompts, or listing methods for System Managers.

nce_events/api/form_dialog/button_visibi.purpose: Evaluate Form Dialog footer and Submit hide_if rules including saved-state modes and read-only SQL.
nce_events/api/form_dialog/button_visibi.read_when: When validating hide_if SQL on Form Dialog save or fetching footer button hidden maps for panel V2.
gotchas: hide_if SQL must be a single SELECT; table tokens {{t:DocType}} expand before evaluation.
SQL hide evaluation fails closed: errors log and treat the button as hidden.

nce_events/api/form_dialog/capture.py.purpose: Form Dialog schema capture from Desk to frozen meta JSON, rebuild, activate, and list by DocType.
nce_events/api/form_dialog/capture.py.read_when: When capturing, rebuilding, activating, or loading Form Dialog definitions for Desk or Vue panel V2.
gotchas: set_form_dialog_active avoids get_doc before UPDATE to prevent MariaDB ER_CHECKREAD deadlock in Desk.

nce_events/api/form_dialog/edit_conditio.purpose: Validate and evaluate Form Dialog related-tab edit conditions as implicit IF SQL against root field values.
nce_events/api/form_dialog/edit_conditio.read_when: When related tabs gate editing via edit_condition SQL, label tokens, or pending unsaved root values before Submit.
gotchas: Edit conditions reject SELECT FROM and semicolons; only scalar root field tokens allowed.
Truthy IF SQL result disables edit and add/remove; empty expression always allows editing.

nce_events/api/form_dialog/portal_action.purpose: Run allow-listed portal actions from Form Dialog related and inline grids with resolved parameters.
nce_events/api/form_dialog/portal_action.read_when: When wiring portal row buttons to registered server methods or handling run_portal_action from the panel.

nce_events/api/form_dialog/portal_fields.purpose: Portal field and action editor for Form Dialog related and inline child rows; grid columns and Desk APIs.
nce_events/api/form_dialog/portal_fields.read_when: When configuring portal_field_config, portal_actions, or whitelisted portal editor APIs on Form Dialog child rows.
gotchas: Editor is Desk-only (System Manager) and persists state on the Form Dialog Related or Inline Child Table child row.
Layout fieldtypes in _PORTAL_EDITOR_SKIP_FIELDTYPES never appear in the related-table portal field editor.

nce_events/api/form_dialog/qbtl_rows.py.purpose: Resolve Query Based Table Link joins to fetch display DocType names for Form Dialog related tabs.
nce_events/api/form_dialog/qbtl_rows.py.read_when: When a related tab uses query_based_table_link instead of a standard link_field child relationship.
gotchas: Blank or zero bind-side join keys mean no relationship; nonempty guard avoids fan-out across empty keys.

nce_events/api/form_dialog/related_rows..purpose: Panel V2 Form Dialog API to fetch, save, add, and delete child rows on related tabs with permlevels.
nce_events/api/form_dialog/related_rows..read_when: When loading or persisting related-tab grids from Vue, including edit_condition and portal_field_config gating.
gotchas: Child write context respects permlevels; guest access is rejected on save endpoints.
Editability follows DocType read_only and Page Panel read_only_fields, not portal editable flags.
Query based link tabs are read-only for save, add, and delete.

nce_events/api/form_dialog/save.py.purpose: Whitelisted panel Form Dialog save with Page Panel required roots, fetch_from writeback, scalar sanitization, and sync job ids.
nce_events/api/form_dialog/save.py.read_when: When panel V2 persists Form Dialog root edits, fetch_from writeback, write permissions, or sync_job_ids polling after save.
gotchas: Scalar fields may arrive as change-event dict payloads; unsanitized dicts trigger PyMySQL TypeError on save.
Truthy writeback_fetches updates linked fetch_from source documents before the parent document is saved.
Existing rows merge onto a fresh DB load so modified reflects concurrent NCE_Sync or listener updates.
Returned sync_job_ids come from nce_sync_queued_job_ids so the client waits for WordPress before releasing the edit lock.

nce_events/api/form_dialog/search.py.purpose: Whitelisted Form Dialog find APIs that query target rows using FileMaker-style terms on frozen meta and panel search fields.
nce_events/api/form_dialog/search.py.read_when: When implementing panel find or multi-field criteria search against frozen Form Dialog field metadata.

nce_events/api/form_dialog/sync_related..purpose: Form Dialog edit locks and post write-back linked-row sync jobs for read-back before showing changes in the panel.
nce_events/api/form_dialog/sync_related..read_when: When wiring dialog submit begin/end locks or enqueueing linked DocType mirror pull-back after WordPress write-back.
gotchas: Only direct related links with empty hop_chain and child DocType in WP Tables Mirrored or Linked qualify.
Dialog write-back and read-back jobs deliberately do not consult edit-lock marks; marks block external syncs and overlapping submits.
begin_dialog_edit fails open if nce_sync is missing or lock infrastructure errors; only a genuine conflict blocks submit.
end_dialog_edit never raises from release because it runs in the submit flow finally block.

nce_events/api/hierarchy_explorer.py.purpose: Legacy whitelisted two-pane hierarchy explorer data and export for recent Events and registered Family Members.
nce_events/api/hierarchy_explorer.py.read_when: When maintaining legacy hierarchy explorer pane pagination or CSV and JSON export including roster file drops.

gotchas: Gemini and OpenAI raise ValidationError as not yet implemented; only Anthropic is wired.

nce_events/api/messaging.py.purpose: Panel bulk and test SMS via Twilio and email via Frappe queue, with Jinja templates on enriched row context.
nce_events/api/messaging.py.read_when: When building panel message dialogs, previews, recipient lists, or Twilio/SendGrid send paths.

nce_events/api/panel_actions.py.purpose: Whitelisted Panel Action lists, Form Dialog capture, and Desk route helpers with role and SPA filtering.
nce_events/api/panel_actions.py.read_when: When panel footer loads get_panel_actions or Form Dialog V2 reads captured frozen_meta_json.

nce_events/api/panel_api_pkg/__init__.py.purpose: Re-export panel SQL, data fetch, discovery, filters, computed columns, and shared panel helpers.
nce_events/api/panel_api_pkg/__init__.py.read_when: When importing from nce_events.api.panel_api_pkg instead of individual submodule paths.

nce_events/api/panel_api_pkg/_helpers.py.purpose: Shared panel and Form Dialog helpers for link fields, contact detection, labels, CSV parsing, and required-root validation.
nce_events/api/panel_api_pkg/_helpers.py.read_when: When panel config, discovery, export, or save needs link lookup, title labels, or required field checks.

nce_events/api/panel_api_pkg/computed_co.purpose: Evaluate Page Panel unstored calculation SQL per row and expose computed fields in panel data.
nce_events/api/panel_api_pkg/computed_co.read_when: When adding or debugging unstored_calculation_fields SQL on Page Panel column definitions.
gotchas: SQL failures per row are stored as {_error: message} on that computed field instead of aborting the panel fetch.

nce_events/api/panel_api_pkg/core_filter.purpose: Merge Page Panel core_filter SQL with dict filters and post-filter row lists for panel queries.
nce_events/api/panel_api_pkg/core_filter.read_when: When panel SQL must combine core_filter with user filters or rewrite bare table names in expressions.

nce_events/api/panel_api_pkg/discovery.p.purpose: Discover inbound links, via-path hops, QBTL bridges, and field lists for Page Panel and Form Dialog capture pickers.
nce_events/api/panel_api_pkg/discovery.p.read_when: When building related-column pickers, get_child_doctypes, or debugging link paths from a root DocType.
gotchas: Singles and virtual DocTypes are skipped because they lack physical child tables for counts.
Group-by same-doctype tabs are not auto-offered in get_multi_hop_children; client merges configured tabs on rebuild.
Via-path discovery skips circular paths when the via target equals the root DocType.

nce_events/api/panel_api_pkg/format_rule.purpose: Rewrite Page Panel format-rule condition SQL to panel column aliases and add CASE flag columns on data fetch.
nce_events/api/panel_api_pkg/format_rule.read_when: When validating format rules, debugging Unknown column errors, or tracing _fmt_ flags in get_panel_data.
gotchas: Conditions target ( panel_sql ) AS pp_rows aliases; bare root fields stay unqualified.
Only shown or search-only columns may be referenced; others fail validation or are skipped at fetch.
RelatedDT.field maps only when exactly one Link targets that DocType.

nce_events/api/panel_api_pkg/page_panel_.purpose: Look up Page Panel records by root_doctype instead of panel name when APIs need the right panel row.
nce_events/api/panel_api_pkg/page_panel_.read_when: When panel_data, SQL save, or Form Dialog search need the Page Panel for a root DocType.
gotchas: Panel name may differ from root_doctype; always query by root_doctype link field.
generate_auto_page_panel_name is for programmatic inserts; Desk creation uses Prompt autoname.

nce_events/api/panel_api_pkg/panel_confi.purpose: Build Page Panel runtime config dict with columns, chrome classes, theme slug, format rules, and derived sort.
nce_events/api/panel_api_pkg/panel_confi.read_when: When assembling panel payload for Vue load, CSV export, panel SQL, or related-rows ORDER BY.
gotchas: Outer ORDER BY is omitted when the configured column is not in display or search fields, avoiding query errors.
Linked-table gender fields are not auto-joined unless explicitly configured in column or search fields.

nce_events/api/panel_api_pkg/panel_data..purpose: Whitelisted Page Panel config and row fetch with permissions, WP Tables catalog filtering, sync columns, and export hooks.
nce_events/api/panel_api_pkg/panel_data..read_when: When implementing panel SPA data loads, WP Tables sync UI columns, or messaging preview row context.
gotchas: WP Tables skips root read gate; unreadable catalog rows are filtered per row instead.
user_filters, limit, and start are ignored; V2 filters and paginates client-side on the full dataset.
panel_sql is read from Page Panel when no drill-down filters; drill-down rebuilds SQL with WHERE.

nce_events/api/panel_api_pkg/panel_expor.purpose: Page Panel CSV export: column lists, CSV text, public file URL, and get_panel REST download path.

gotchas: filtered_row_names must be a JSON array and is capped at 50000 names.

nce_events/api/panel_api_pkg/sql.py.purpose: Build parameterized SELECT SQL for Page Panel grids from column config, link JOINs, drill-down filters, and sort order.
nce_events/api/panel_api_pkg/sql.py.read_when: When tracing panel_sql generation, stored query refresh, or how get_panel_data executes panel rows.
gotchas: Drill-down filters bind in WHERE at fetch time; they are not stored in cached panel_sql.
Format rule _fmt_ columns are excluded from panel_sql; get_panel_data wraps the query at fetch time.
Related-table fetch_only fields need Display, Search, or Gender Column selection or they are skipped.

nce_events/api/panel_api_pkg/theme_slug..purpose: Resolve Page Panel NCE Theme links to active theme slug strings for panel chrome and data-nce-theme.
nce_events/api/panel_api_pkg/theme_slug..read_when: When panel or preview code needs the active slug from a Page Panel theme Link or site default NCE Theme.
gotchas: Empty theme link uses site default NCE Theme (is_default=1) only if that doc is Active.
Explicit theme link never redirects; missing or inactive theme returns None so callers may omit data-nce-theme.

nce_events/api/panel_api_pkg/theme_table.purpose: Resolve NCE Theme table divider tiers and colour hex tokens for Page Panel Desk previews and Colours tab.
nce_events/api/panel_api_pkg/theme_table.read_when: When Colours tab or panel_data needs table chrome defaults from linked theme JSON or site default.

nce_events/api/spa_page.py.purpose: Look up SPA Page Definition rows, routes, and switch_page handler slugs for Desk SPA navigation.
nce_events/api/spa_page.py.read_when: When resolve_spa_switch, panel switch actions, or booting get_spa_page_config by slug.

nce_events/api/sql_eval.py.purpose: Server-side MariaDB scalar SQL evaluation against row dicts with DocType token allowlists and whitelisted APIs.
nce_events/api/sql_eval.py.read_when: When fixing derived field SQL, Form Dialog evaluate_sql_expressions_api, or row token substitution and bind coercion.
gotchas: Expressions must come from trusted configuration such as WP Tables, not end-user text.
Bare identifier substitution applies only outside single-quoted string literals in each expression.

nce_events/api/sync_status.py.purpose: Whitelisted sync gate and background job status for panel UI during WP Tables sync.
nce_events/api/sync_status.py.read_when: When the panel must block actions during sync or poll RQ job state for status indicators.

nce_events/api/tags.py.purpose: Build gender-conditional Jinja pronoun tags for Tag Finder when a DocType has a gender field.
nce_events/api/tags.py.read_when: When Tag Finder or schema explorer needs get_pronoun_tags_for_doctype pronoun field paths.

nce_events/api/tests/api/form_dialog/tes.read_when: When refactoring _helpers or submodule gating and QBTL related parse utilities.
